summary: OceanaGold, a Canadian-domiciled, US-listed gold miner, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a news release dated September 9, 2026, announcing it lodged a Fast-track Approvals Act 2024 application for the Macraes Phase 4 project in New Zealand, seeking to extend mine life from the current 2032 reserve life to the late 2030s. The release also summarizes supporting technical study work and exploration drill results. No transaction, security, or capital-markets event; this is an ordinary permitting and operational update, not a special situation.
